gen-fs-panchang-gf-science-gothic: Panchang draws its letters with the taut steadiness of a pulled string, and its bowls never close up on themselves. Science Gothic follows with stroke ends set far apart, so a long page moves one unhurried letter at a time.
gen-fs-panchang-gf-syncopate: Confident lettering up top, Panchang leaves generous blank space between every stem and curve, and nothing in it snags. And Syncopate, a technical-pen sans-serif, carries on in that spirit, so a long page keeps a measured, rung-by-rung rhythm.
gen-fs-panchang-manrope: Expressive and sure of itself, Panchang runs its strokes like a drawn string with open space around each curve. Manrope sits lower and taller in the lowercase, a minimal step from capitals, so the sans-serif underneath feels bright beside the display type.
gen-fs-panchang-switzer: Taut and spacious, Panchang puts open blank between each stem and curve. Switzer, a tall-waisted sans with wire-like tubular letters, keeps its c tips well apart, and that wiry clarity is what lifts the pair.
gen-fs-panchang-work-sans: Wide-open display swagger, with Panchang drawing its bowls so they never snag. Work Sans, a plain sans with a high mean line, keeps its c tips apart and its joins sturdy, which is what holds the pair together.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps sharp, refined lines and leaves generous room where its curves meet the stem. Quilon, above it, adds a soft nib-like swell, so the plain sans feels crisp and the heading feels commanding.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-abeezee: Editorial in tone, Quilon sets sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems and gives its tall a, e and s large open counters. ABeeZee's strength is its tube-like uniformity.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-amiko: Quilon brings robust downstrokes and slender turns, a comfortable contrast with real editorial authority. Amiko answers in a plain sans with chunky crayon-tall lowercase and terminals that point outward, so the page feels sturdy and modern.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding in the heading, Quilon thins softly like stamped soft metal and opens its tall a, e and s wide. Anek Devanagari just reads cleanly.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-gujarati: A calm ebb and flow of stroke thickness gives Quilon its editorial presence, with just a light touch of modulation. Anek Gujarati is the quiet worker, its lowercase rivaling capitals.
